title: What's new: Server and Database (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: AL runtime: .NET 10, Excel streaming, recent records virtual table
Database optimization: table extensions data model history
Zero-join table extension benefits and performance
Index management: discoverability improvements and Tell me integration
Index management: runtime enablement and cross-table indexes
System fields in analysis mode and profiles
Security: permissions overview navigation and telemetry for Excel exports

features.name: .NET 10 runtime
features.description: The AL runtime now runs on .NET 10, the latest version of .NET, bringing all the improvements of that platform.

features.name: Streaming-based Excel import
features.description: Streaming implementation for opening Excel files that reduces memory usage and prevents out-of-memory exceptions when loading large Excel files.

features.name: Recent records virtual table
features.description: A new virtual table exposed to AL that allows querying and deletion of recent records that appear in the UI when opening pages, providing a read-only view of recently accessed records.

features.name: Optimized table extensions data model - zero-join
features.description: Table extension fields are now stored back on the base table instead of separate tables, eliminating all joins when reading base and extension fields together.

features.name: Table extension performance gains
features.description: Operations including read, delete, update, insert and modify are up to 30 percent faster due to eliminating joins, with potential to speed up page loading times in Business Central.

features.name: Index management improvements
features.description: Enhanced index management with multiple discoverability improvements including Tell me integration with semantic search support, a new manage indexes button, and a reorganized index management page.

features.name: Runtime-controlled index enablement
features.description: Indexes can now be defined with enabled equal false and controlled at runtime using set.logic logic to enable or disable keys based on feature usage or other conditions.

features.name: Cross-table indexes
features.description: Indexes can now span both base table and extension fields, a capability that was previously requested multiple times and is now enabled by the consolidated table structure.

features.name: System fields in analysis mode
features.description: System fields like created by, created on, last modified by, last modified on and system ID are now visible in analysis mode data pickers and column pickers for creating audit-like reports.
caveats: system fields were previously added ten release waves ago

features.name: System fields in profiles
features.description: System fields including modified by and modified at can now be included in profiles when designing profile layouts via the page designer.

features.name: Permissions overview navigation
features.description: Context-aware navigation to the permissions overview page from permission sets list, permission set cards, and table information pages to show where permissions are used.

features.name: Telemetry for Excel export audit
features.description: New telemetry tag RT 0056 tracks who opens data in Excel, enabling audit answers to who did what when for fraud prevention scenarios like disgruntled employees exporting customer or vendor lists.
